definitions.explanation: A young person, or someone's son or daughter.

examples.japanese: あの{子|こ}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}、よくここで{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: I often played here when I was a child.

notes:
{子|こ} is a fundamental word meaning child. It functions both as a standalone word and as a productive element in many compounds.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いい{子|こ}: good child (also used to praise pets)
- {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}: boy
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ}: girl
- あの{子|こ}: that child/kid (casual; also used for young adults)

AS A PREFIX (= young/baby):
- {子犬|こいぬ}: puppy
- {子猫|こねこ}: kitten
- {子鹿|こじか}: fawn
- {子牛|こうし}: calf

IN COMPOUNDS:
- {親子|おやこ}: parent and child
- {子供|こども}: children (most common form)
- {子育|こそだ}て: child-rearing

USAGE:
あの{子|こ} can refer to young adults casually, not just children. In this usage, it is similar to "that person" but informal.
